short_notes:
‣ New grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview model!
‣ New Compact Chat feature!
‣ Bug fixes and improvements
long_notes:
Hi everyone! Earlier today xAI released a brand new Imagine model made specifically for image-to-video: grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview! It offers the latest and the greatest from the best of the best when it comes to video generation (and yes, that's a catchphrase from the FAPA!). 

Additionally, I added support for xAI's new Compaction API within chats. It lets you compress all the messages in a chat into one object, so you can continue the chat at a reduced price, at the cost of possibly losing a few details from the conversation history. xAI has effectively made this context compaction available only to chats that are stored locally in iCloud. You can find this feature in the "✏️Edit Chat" option in each chat. 

Lastly, I fixed many bugs that I found. I hope you all enjoy!
